title: Petition of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid and Western Massachusetts Electric Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3, for Certain Exemptions from the Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Palmer and the Zoning Bylaws of the Towns of Monson and Hampden, Massachusetts, in connection with the proposed construction of a new 115 kV Transmission Line, a New Substation, and Related Improvements.
petitioner: New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Assign Hearing Officer, Stephen August. DPU 10-107
DPU Chair issues Order consolidating DPU 10-107 and 10-108 with EFSB 10-1

Petition of New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid and Western Massachusetts Electric Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 40A, § 3, for Certain Exemptions from the Zoning Ordinance of the Town of Palmer and the Zoning Bylaws of the Towns of Monson and Hampden, Massachusetts, in connection with the proposed construction of a new 115 kV Transmission Line, a New Substation, and Related Improvements. Appearances of Counsel of Bess B. Gorman and Lauren Peloquin, James M. Avery and Allyson L. Roklan on behalf of National Grid. Appearance of Counsel of Stephen Klionsky on behalf of Western Massachusetts Electric Company. Companies' Motion for Consolidation and Referral of its Petitions to the Energy Facilities Siting Board. Direct Testimony of Liana P. Moore.
Companies file the following documents: Exh. LPM-3 (Town of Palmer Zoining Ordinance); Exh. LPM-5 (Town of Monson Zoning Bylaw); and Exh. LPM-7 (Town of Hampden Zoning Bylaw).
